name: Foreman
description: A chief-of-staff agent for Orca: send it Linear tickets and it runs supervised workers for them, keeping everything that needs you in one queue.

settings.title: Home folder
settings.description: The Foreman's own folder, outside any repo. Created if missing and added to Orca as a folder project. Holds the tickets you sent, its preferences, repo map and worker specs.

settings.title: Linear team
settings.description: Limits “Your open tickets” in the panel to this team. Leave empty for every team. Search always covers all of Linear.

settings.title: Working state
settings.description: Workflow state the Foreman moves a ticket to when its worker starts.

settings.title: Review state
settings.description: Workflow state workers move a ticket to when it needs you: a PR to review or a question to answer.

settings.title: Agent
settings.description: Orca agent id for the Foreman and its workers, as `orca agent launch --agent` takes it.

settings.title: Orca CLI
settings.description: Command or absolute path of the `orca` CLI the worker runs to read Linear and add the home folder.
